standing_rules.name: Absurd Shit rule
standing_rules.source: Gustav: "I'm making an 'Absurd Shit'-rule: if it's too absurd to say if it's SF or Fantasy, and it's not even a Fabulation: kill it"
standing_rules.apply: Autonomous, no per-case ask: if a book is too absurd to call SF or Fantasy AND fits no Fabulation node, exclude as not SFF. Log each kill in sweep.log as '-Title (Absurd Shit rule)' and in excluded[] with reason citing the rule.
